limitations: Baseline-only comparison, not a replay of full historical XI, tactical, possession or opponent interactions.
Historical proxy uses fixed .34 accuracy when missing own venue history; published case is replayed exactly only for the cap operation.
Candidates declared after observing the symptom; MD9-10 is a descriptive temporal check, not an untouched holdout.
100 side forecasts correspond to 50 dependent match clusters; no statistical superiority claim.
Current overall means mix venues and opponents. Venue pooling and opponent-strength normalization remain to validate.
No direct Serie B to Serie A equivalence in candidate baselines.

uncertainty.comparison: MAE candidate minus legacy proxy; negative is better
uncertainty.note: Descriptive interval only; excludes model selection, input revision and proxy uncertainty.
